snippet.title: How the Best Captain Would Have Saved This Learjet
snippet.description:
On November 1, 2026, a Learjet 60 fell from 35,000 feet over Palm Beach County, Florida. All nine people on board were killed. Since then, pilots have argued about one question: could anyone have saved it?

This film tests that question with a fictional captain, Captain Hale. Same jet, same storm, same afternoon. At each of the seven points where the real flight made a decision, we stop and ask what the best captain would do, using the FAA’s own guidance: the briefing, the route, the descent, the radar, the storm, the climb, and the 77-second dive. Then we take his hindsight away.

Please read this first:

- Captain Hale is fictional. This is a theory, not a reconstruction, and nothing in it is a finding.
- The NTSB has not determined a cause and has not found fault with anyone. Nothing here says what the real crew did or did not do.
- The 3D (Blender) is illustrative. The aircraft is modelled on photos of N722BD. Screens, the briefing tablet, the SIGMET page and the controller’s display are illustrations of reported information, not recordings or original documents.
- Radio lines are quoted as reported from LiveATC recordings and the NTSB. No final audio is used.
- Facts are as of November 7, 2026. We’ll revisit when the NTSB’s preliminary report comes out.

If you have photos, video or information about this crash, the NTSB asks you to email witness@ntsb.gov.

Our thoughts are with the families of all nine people on board.

Babasının sözleri Teoman’ın Aras’a duyduğu güveni sarsar; Deniz ve Metin ise ona yardım eder. snippet.title: 거제 바닷가 마을에서 무심코 지나치는 이 돌 성, 매미성
snippet.description:
경남 거제시 장목면 복항마을의 매미성은 2003년 9월 태풍 매미로 바닷가 밭(약 600평)의 흙을 잃은 백 씨가 남은 밭을 지키려고 쌓기 시작한 돌 둑입니다. 본인 인터뷰로는 시에 복구를 부탁했지만 사유지이고 피해가 크지 않다는 답을 들었다고 합니다. 설계도와 중장비 없이 20~60kg짜리 화강암 2만여 개를 원래 있던 바위 위와 틈에 올리고 시멘트로 메워, 성벽이 바위를 따라 굽습니다. 성벽 일부가 공유수면을 넘어 변상금을 내고 그 부분을 거제시에 기증했고, 부지 소유는 보도마다 표현이 엇갈립니다. 방문객 수는 YTN 보도(2023년 58만7천여 명)를 따랐고 매체마다 다릅니다.

snippet.title: トレーラーと中型トラックが正面衝突「トレーラーが大破…運転手が見えない」トレーラー運転の男性が死亡 滋賀・野洲市（2026年11月9日）
snippet.description:
滋賀県野洲市の県道でトレーラーとトラックが衝突する事故があり、トレーラーの運転手が死亡しました。

11月9日午前3時半ごろ、滋賀県野洲市の県道で「トレーラーが大破していて運転手が見えない」と中型トラックの運転手から110番通報がありました。

警察によりますと、トレーラーと、中型トラックが正面衝突し、トレーラーを運転していた福岡県豊前市の東健太郎さん（48）が頭を強く打って意識不明の状態で病院に運ばれ、その後、脳挫傷で死亡しました。

中型トラックを運転していた53歳の男性は全身打撲で搬送されましたが、軽傷だということです。

中型トラックの運転手は「相手がセンターラインをはみ出してきた」という趣旨の話をしているということで、警察が事故の原因を慎重に調べています。

snippet.title: Ciri-Ciri Ya'juj Ma'juj dan Dinding yang Runtuh | Akhir Zaman Episode 5
snippet.description:
Ya'juj Ma'juj bukan monster. Mereka manusia, sama-sama keturunan Adam, dan justru itu yang bikin serem.

Episode 5 dari 10 seri animasi Kalau Lu Hidup di Akhir Zaman. Dinding yang dulu dibangun Dzulqarnain runtuh, dan mereka turun dengan cepat dari setiap tempat yang tinggi. Rombongan pertama minum air Danau Thabariyah, dan rombongan terakhir cuma bilang: kayaknya dulu di sini ada airnya. Lu naik ke Bukit Thur bareng Nabi Isa, makanan makin habis, dan semua orang ngangkat tangan berdoa.

Di video ini:
• Siapa Ya'juj Ma'juj, dan kenapa mereka bukan raksasa atau monster
• Ciri-ciri Ya'juj Ma'juj menurut riwayat
• Dinding Dzulqarnain yang runtuh dan Danau Thabariyah yang kering
• Panah ke langit, Bukit Thur, dan doa Nabi Isa
• Masa paling damai: hujan yang nyuci bumi dan satu delima buat serombongan orang

Rujukan:
QS. Al-Kahfi 94–97: dinding Dzulqarnain
QS. Al-Anbiya 96: mereka turun dari setiap tempat yang tinggi
HR. Muslim 2937: Danau Thabariyah, panah ke langit, Bukit Thur, kepala sapi lebih berharga dari seratus dinar, ulat di leher mereka, burung, hujan, delima
HR. Ahmad: ciri wajah mereka (sanadnya dinilai lemah)

Catatan: riwayat tentang ciri wajah Ya'juj Ma'juj sanadnya dinilai lemah oleh sebagian ahli hadis, jadi di video diberi label. Dalam HR. Muslim 2937 mereka mati serentak, "seperti matinya satu jiwa". Gambaran telinga raksasa atau tubuh sangat tinggi tidak punya dasar yang kuat. Urutan kejadian di seri ini salah satu cara menyusun riwayat. Kota lu di video ini kota fiktif di Syam.

snippet.title: Stop Buying Round Pencils for Your Kids!
snippet.description:
Can your handwriting reveal your personality? Does being left-handed make someone more creative? And can improving handwriting actually help students perform better?

In this Telugu Podcast,@akshaypabba sits down with Dr Y. Mallikarjuna Rao, Handwriting Trainer, to explore the fascinating world of handwriting, graphology, signatures, writing techniques and children's learning habits. Stop Buying Round Pencils for Your Kids!

From the differences between left-handed and right-handed writing to the role of handwriting in education, this conversation explores several interesting questions about how we write, learn and express ourselves.

In This Telugu Podcast, We Discuss:

Can handwriting reveal someone's personality?
Left-handed vs right-handed writing and common myths
Can you write with both hands?
Why parents shouldn't force children to change their natural writing hand
How to hold a pen or pencil correctly
Cursive vs print handwriting
What graphology claims to reveal about human behaviour
Signature analysis and writing patterns
Handwriting in the digital age
The role of parents in developing children's writing habits
Different types of pens and their unique features
Can better handwriting help students in examinations?

Throughout this conversation, Dr Y. Mallikarjuna Rao shares his experiences, observations and views from the field of handwriting training.

Note: Some interpretations discussed in graphology and signature analysis are the guest's views and should not be treated as scientifically established methods of personality assessment.
